Native front shell contains two closed inward negative-volume interior boundaries;source arrays retained without reversal or repair.
Own raw source does not identify the2021 smaller-wheel hardware revision;wheel and concealed mechanism are exact-product photo/source-opening inferences,not measured production CAD.
No encoder detent count,pulse synthesis,thermal acquisition,temperature conversion,power/electrical or firmware behavior inferred.
inferred: Concealed PCB/package/battery/camera module installation and supporting ribs
LCD effective rectangle14.8x24.86mm derived from own nominal diagonal and aperture ratio;not a certified panel drawing
Connector depths,hidden contacts/tails and bore stops
Normalized A0.22/B0.16/power0.15mm native material field and0.18mm encoder shaft travel
Encoder radius3.45mm fitted to own source opening and own reduced-wheel photo;not rated travel,detents or mounting tolerance

scope: Visual geometry,input intent,external framebuffer and encoder angle only;physical fit,temperature,electrical,firmware and bus validation external.
